name: accessoticketing-mcp
description: Read accesso-powered mobile ticket links: orders, admissions, barcodes and Google Wallet passes.
long_description: Reads the mobile-ticket links accesso Passport venues email after a purchase (theme parks, camps, festivals). Returns the order and every admission on it — product, participant, date, start time and merchant instructions — plus the scannable barcodes and Google Wallet save links. No login: the emailed link is the credential.

tools.name: accesso_get_order
tools.description: Read an accesso ticket link: the order number and every admission on it — product, participant, date, start time, barcode text, and the merchant instructions.

tools.name: accesso_get_ticket
tools.description: One admission from an accesso order in full detail, including the merchant instructions and (on request) the terms.

tools.name: accesso_save_barcodes
tools.description: Save the scannable barcode images from an accesso order. Writes PNGs and returns their paths; set inline to receive the images directly instead.

tools.name: accesso_get_wallet_passes
tools.description: Google Wallet save links for the tickets on an accesso order. Not every merchant enables passes.

tools.name: accesso_resolve_link
tools.description: Turn an order-confirmation email's click-tracking link into the direct accesso ticket URL it wraps.

tools.name: accesso_healthcheck
tools.description: Check that this server can reach accesso and whether a default ticket link is configured.

ticket_url.title: Default ticket link
ticket_url.description: Optional. An accesso ticket link from an order-confirmation email, used when a tool is called without one. Treat it as a secret — it grants the order's tickets.

output_dir.title: Barcode output directory
output_dir.description: Optional. Where saved barcode images are written. Defaults to the working directory, or ~/Downloads when that is the filesystem root (as under Claude Desktop).

no_file_output.title: Return barcodes inline
no_file_output.description: Set where the filesystem isn't the user's (a hosted deployment) so barcodes return inline.
